一下午王野都在忙里忙外，准备吃食，打扫卫生。其实在内心深处，王野是很重视这次拜师的。因为这是王野和前世的牵绊。在王野的内心很怀念捡破烂的老头，想报答他的养育之恩。

红烧兔肉，一锅猪肉炖粉条，炖了一只野鸡，再加上两个素菜，这一桌在当下非常丰盛了。王野还专门买了两瓶汾酒。这酒已经相当有排面了。王野也想买茅台，但怕太张扬了。

一晃而过，一下午时间很快就过去了。到了6点多钟，王铁柱、赵爷爷、吴叔和刘叔一起回来了。王野把三人都叫进家里，前后脚，李叔也回家了，一样来到王爷家。在所有人落座，王野站在王铁柱身后，这算是王野少有的正经的时候。

赵爷爷先开口说话了：“今天把各位邻居叫来，是为了王野的事情，各位也是老邻居了，今天的事儿就是让各位做个见证。老头子会点庄稼把式，同时又和王野小子有缘。今儿就让我徒弟收王野入门。”吴志强起身抱拳。

赵爷爷点点头，示意吴志强坐下，继续说：“咱们新时代新气象，也不搞原来乱七八糟的礼节了，王野，来来来。”

王野上前毕恭毕敬的站在堂屋正中。

赵爷爷面色郑重：“小野，咱这一门没有什么规矩，就一条，莫要伤天害理。”

王野有样学样的抱拳深鞠躬：“谨记赵爷爷教诲！”

赵爷爷欣慰一笑：“给你师傅敬杯茶，咱就算是礼成了。”

秦婉递给王野一杯茶，王野分别给师父和赵爷爷敬茶。

在李叔刘叔的恭贺后，王铁柱招呼众人入座。众人看着王野和秦婉一盘一盘的上菜。

李伟调侃：“王哥，你家这拜师宴可够丰盛的呀！”

刘叔也附和道：“是呀！王哥，这一顿一般人家过年都吃不上呀！”

王铁柱嘿嘿笑着说：“这可和我没关系，这都是小野自己准备的。”

李伟说：“嚯！原来满院子乱跑的臭小子，现在长大了。”

王野一脸的坏笑：“李叔，我都16了，能不大吗，我可听我李婶说，你和我李婶16都搞对象了。”

李伟俩眼一瞪：“嘿，你个臭小子，胆肥了啊！连你李叔都敢调笑了是吧？”

一顿饭吃的宾主尽欢。到了八点多，众人才散去。王野跟着赵爷爷回到他的小屋。赵爷爷坐在炕头上，王野坐在凳子上。

赵爷爷一脸正色：“我是八极门第七代传人，咱这一脉早年人数挺多，分支也就很多，就是海那边也有分支。但是其他分支只得其形，不得其意。”

赵爷爷顿了一下继续说：“有一句话是十年太极不出门，一年八极打死人，这句话一个是说八极杀伤力大，也是说八极入门容易。八极入门虽容易，想练到极致就难了。”

“江湖上把练功的境界分为入门，明劲，暗劲和化劲。化劲的境界我没见过，但是早年我没受伤前，曾经摸到了化劲的门槛儿。造化弄人啊！九死一生，境界也发挥不出来了。”

“你师父原来是暗劲中期，也算是可造之材。现在只能发挥出明劲高层的实力了。我们这种身带暗伤的不能拼命，都得压制境界。真要是全力以赴，也是昙花一现。”

王野疑惑的问：“那赵爷爷，我是什么境界。”

赵爷爷毫不吝啬夸奖：“你也算个异类，现在应该是明劲初期了。能这么短时间里度过入门，自己摸索进入明劲期，说明你悟性很高。”

“再加上你的体质也特殊，又有你老家的爷爷给的药丸，综合起来也就合理了，这都是机缘。只要你不出意外，说不定真有一天可以进入化劲期。”

Wang Ye was busy all afternoon, preparing food and cleaning.In fact, deep down in his heart, Wang Ye attached great importance to this apprenticeship.Because this is the tie between Wang Ye and his previous life.In Wang Ye's heart, he missed the old man who picked up rags and wanted to repay him for his upbringing.

Braised rabbit, a pot of pork stewed with vermicelli, a stewed pheasant, plus two vegetarian dishes, this table is very rich at the moment.Wang Ye also bought two bottles of Fenjiu.This wine is already quite impressive.Wang Ye also wanted to buy Maotai, but he was afraid of being too public.

In a flash, the afternoon passed quickly.At around 6 o'clock, Wang Tiezhu, Grandpa Zhao, Uncle Wu and Uncle Liu came back together.Wang Ye called all three people into his home. Uncle Li also came home and came to the prince's house.After everyone was seated, Wang Ye stood behind Wang Tiezhu. This was a rare moment for Wang Ye to be serious.

Grandpa Zhao spoke first: "I called all the neighbors here today because of Wang Ye's affairs. You are also old neighbors. What I want to do today is for you to be witnesses. The old man knows how to do the crops, and at the same time he has a relationship with Wang Ye. Today, I will let my apprentice accept Wang Ye as his apprentice." Wu Zhiqiang stood up and clasped his fists.

Grandpa Zhao nodded, motioned for Wu Zhiqiang to sit down, and continued: "We have a new era and a new atmosphere, and we will no longer engage in the messy etiquette we used to have. Wang Ye, come on, come on."

Wang Ye stepped forward and stood respectfully in the middle of the hall.

Grandpa Zhao looked solemn: "Xiaoye, there are no rules in our sect, there is only one rule, don't harm nature."

Wang Ye followed suit and clasped his fists and bowed deeply: "Remember Grandpa Zhao's teachings!"

Grandpa Zhao smiled happily: "I'll toast your master with a cup of tea, and we'll consider it a done deal."

Qin Wan handed Wang Ye a cup of tea, and Wang Ye served tea to Master and Grandpa Zhao respectively.

After Uncle Li and Uncle Liu congratulated each other, Wang Tiezhu invited everyone to take their seats.Everyone watched Wang Ye and Qin Wan serving dishes one after another.

Li Wei joked: "Brother Wang, your apprenticeship banquet is quite sumptuous!"

Uncle Liu also echoed: "Yes! Brother Wang, most people can't afford this meal during the Chinese New Year!"

Wang Tiezhu chuckled and said, "This has nothing to do with me. This is all prepared by Xiaoye himself."

Li Wei said: "Oh! The brat who used to run around the yard has grown up now."

Wang Ye had a bad smile on his face: "Uncle Li, I'm already 16, how can I be older? I heard my Aunt Li say that you and I are already dating at the age of 16."

Li Wei glared: "Hey, you brat, you're so cowardly! Even your Uncle Li dares to make fun of you, right?"

The guests and hosts enjoy a meal together.It wasn't until after eight o'clock that everyone dispersed.Wang Ye followed Grandpa Zhao back to his cabin.Grandpa Zhao sat on the head of the kang, and Wang Ye sat on the stool.

Grandpa Zhao looked serious: "I am the seventh generation descendant of the Baji Sect. In the early years, our lineage had a large number of people, and there were many branches. There are also branches across the sea. But the other branches only have their own shape, not their meaning."

Grandpa Zhao paused and continued: "There is a saying that if you don't go out in Tai Chi for ten years, you will kill someone with Baji in one year. This sentence means that Baji is very lethal, and it also means that it is easy to get started with Baji. Although it is easy to get started with Baji, it is difficult to practice it to the extreme."

"On the martial arts world, the realms of practicing Kung Fu are divided into entry level, Ming Jin, Dark Jin and Hua Jin. I have never seen the realm of Hua Jin, but in the early years before I was injured, I had touched the threshold of Hua Jin. Fortune plays a trick on people! After a narrow escape, the realm cannot be fully realized."

"Your master turned out to be in the middle stage of Anjin, and he can be considered a man of talent. Now he can only use the strength of the upper echelon of Mingjin. Those of us with hidden injuries can't fight hard, we have to suppress the realm. If we really go all out, it will be short-lived."

Wang Ye asked doubtfully: "Grandpa Zhao, what state am I in?"

Grandpa Zhao did not hesitate to praise: "You are also considered an outlier. You should be in the early stage of Mingjin now. Being able to get through the introduction and enter the Mingjin stage by yourself in such a short time shows that you have a high level of understanding."

"Coupled with your special physique and the pills given by your grandfather in your hometown, it makes sense. This is all a chance. As long as nothing happens to you, you might be able to enter the transformation stage one day."
